aberdeen.note: Premiership clubs enter in the fourth round. The licensed feed currently starts at the First Round and does not carry the preliminary rounds.

coverage.note: The licensed feed covers 66 of 136 ties (First Round, Second Round, Third Round). The page labels the gap rather than inventing ties.
